method: Independent exact-export review of actual full-resolution images, primary morphology references, decoded geometry, raw automated reports and recovered target-renderer CI evidence. Scope and limitations are stated below.
observations: Fresh static audit agrees with the shipped file: 7,736 triangles, 15,450 exported POSITION-stream vertices, 3 primitives/materials, 420,508 bytes; no UVs, tangents, images, external resources or extensions. Authored/evaluated source vertices are 4,236; stream vertices are separately reported.

Official Khronos report has zero errors and zero warnings. All raw report hashes were checked. Fresh Blender 4.3.2 source/export comparison with script autoexecution disabled confirms 7,736 source/export triangles and 9.313225746154785e-09 m maximum axis-converted bounds error. Source is read-only and was not saved.

Fresh factory-startup standalone GLB import succeeds with matching counts/bounds. Its smooth-face warning is reviewed against the intentional custom normals and actual pixels. Its 15,450 raw boundary edges result from normal/material stream splitting; independent exact-position weld has zero boundary edges and every edge incident to two triangles. This does not certify intersection freedom.

Separate bounded-queue rebuild request/result binds the generator/config and exact rebuilt GLB; raw rebuilt SHA equals candidate SHA and normalized semantic digest is a3cd09d437bc39f0c98028bcd6bd19e0b1ef6fe26b0dc02142776f484dcc5b03. This is measured equality plus recorded execution provenance, not cryptographic proof of authoring.

warning_review.warning: source: Curved pinnate frond 01: smooth faces require intentional-style review
warning_review.rationale: Independently inspected exact GLB 512px clay/detail and all 24 768px target-renderer frames. Quad-pair custom normals produce coherent broad blade shading without a broad diagonal checker pattern. Position-welded export has 11,604 edges each incident to two triangles; source parts have no boundary or nonmanifold edges. Deliberate mixed faceted/custom-normal styling is consistent with the brief.
